title: Đây là thịt lợn, thịt bò hay thịt gà?
englishTitle: Is this pork, beef, or chicken?
pronunciation: Day la thit lon thit bo hay thit ga
summary: Is this pork, beef, or chicken?

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Đây là thịt lợn, thịt bò hay thịt gà? is a compact first move in a stall, cafe, or busy counter.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Use Đây là thịt lợn, thịt bò hay thịt gà? when you are almost sure but want confirmation. Hold up the option you mean, then pause for yes, no, or a correction.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Ask before you move, pay, enter, board, sign, or choose.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Menus and photos do a lot of work. Point to the item while you say the phrase so the reply can stay short.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Once they answer, listen for whether I am allergic to fish sauce, I am allergic to shellfish, and I cannot eat this because of an allergy.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the answer changes what you need, try no meat, please; can you make it without this ingredient?; which dish is safest for this allergy?
